metadata.description: Non-normative sample validation_report artifact shaped for Validation Engine / Compiler.

findings.title: Schema Validation Failed
findings.description: JSON does not validate against the required Knowledge Record or overlay schema.
findings.recommended_action: Fix schema violations listed in validation_report and re-validate.

findings.title: Unknown Academic Source
findings.description: Cited SRC-* is not present in bibliography.json.
findings.recommended_action: Register the source via bibliography governance or remove the invalid citation.

findings.title: Placeholder Source Used
findings.description: Citation references a bibliography source with status placeholder.
findings.recommended_action: Allow for draft compiles; block Official until source metadata is promoted.

notes: Example only — does not represent a real compile of PACK_01 or KR records.
Finding codes MUST exist in error_registry.json.
Severity/title/description/recommended_action should be copied from the registry at emit time.
